obligations.target: Verify that in Microsoft Edge with camera permission granted, the live webcam viewfinder displays the video feed, recognizes a scanned code, populates the registration ID field, and advances registration.
obligations.reason: Live camera stream rendering, viewfinder video feed display, and barcode recognition in Microsoft Edge are observable only end-to-end in a real browser session.

obligations.target: Verify that when camera permission is denied or dismissed in Microsoft Edge, a camera unavailable notice is displayed, the manual ID field remains editable, and manual submission succeeds.
obligations.reason: Browser permission denial states, resulting user-visible fallback notices, and interactive manual submission require an end-to-end browser session.

obligations.target: Verify that camera permission granted to the registration site origin in Microsoft Edge is not automatically inherited by external or third-party origins in the same browser session.
obligations.reason: Cross-origin permission isolation and browser security boundaries across distinct origins can only be validated in an end-to-end browser session.

obligations.target: Verify that while the webcam viewfinder is actively streaming in Microsoft Edge, manual ID entry remains interactive, accepts submission, and advances registration.
obligations.reason: Verifying manual entry interaction and successful registration submission concurrently with an active webcam video stream requires an end-to-end browser environment.

obligations.target: Verify that presenting an invalid barcode displays a visible scan error or retry message, keeps the live webcam feed active for another attempt, and maintains manual entry access.
obligations.reason: Asserting that an active webcam video stream remains open across failed scan attempts while displaying retry messages requires browser end-to-end testing.

obligations.target: Verify that when no webcam hardware is available in Microsoft Edge, the page displays a camera not detected notice and presents manual ID entry as the primary input method.
obligations.reason: Browser-level media device detection failure and page fallback presentation on load are observable only in an end-to-end browser environment.
